title: phaca astragalina
intro: Phaca astragalina, commonly known as Huang Qi, is a plant species in the legume family, Fabaceae. It is a perennial herb native to China, traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Huang Qi include tonifying the Qi, nourishing the body, and enhancing immune function, making it a popular remedy for conditions such as fatigue, anemia, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Phaca astragalina include saponins, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable herb in traditional Chinese medicine.
